topics.label: Lecture introduction and learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture series, outlines the learning outcomes, and sets the course context for the students.

topics.label: Cancer as a failure of genetic regulation and tissue differentiation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics introduce cancer as a multistep disease driven by genetic changes and a failure of developmental tissue architecture, discussing the models used to study it.

topics.label: Distinguishing benign and malignant tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics establish the clinical criteria, invasive behaviors, and nomenclature that distinguish benign neoplasms from malignant tumors.

topics.label: Mechanisms of cancer morbidity and mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physical and systemic mechanisms through which primary and metastatic tumors impair normal physiological functions to cause illness and death.

topics.label: Tumor incidence across humans and other species
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics compare the frequency and distribution of different tumor types in human populations and across other animal taxa.

topics.label: Clinical presentation and cancer screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how tumors present clinically and the methods and challenges of screening populations for pre-malignant and early-stage disease.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with a review of the learning outcomes and housekeeping remarks for upcoming sessions.
